summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing daily open-market repurchases under its buy-back programme announced 5 August 2026: 1,481,000 ordinary shares (US$0.50 par) bought on UK venues at a volume-weighted average of US$15.0258 (range US$14.9520–15.0860), and 368,800 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at a HK$160.1021 VWAP, for cancellation. Cumulative repurchases total 17,968,214 shares for about US$370.3m; issued capital stands at 17,169,955,783 shares with no treasury holdings. BNP Paribas Financial Markets SNC executes; watch buy-back pace and HK cancellation timing.
